title: KB Session Indexed
description: Emitted by kb sync (src/commands/sync.rs, source='kb.sync'), kb ingest-sessions (src/commands/ingest_sessions.rs, source='kb.ingest-sessions', newly-indexed+passed sessions only), and kb watch's session-started and bead-complete handlers (src/commands/watch.rs, source='watch.session.started' / 'watch.bead_complete') when a new session or research artifact is written to index.yaml. AMENDED 2026-08-23 (kb-recall-loop emission re-audit): the prior 'Emitted by kb ingest-sessions and kb watch (research.cycle.completed handler)' line undercounted the emitters — kb sync was missing entirely and the two watch.rs call sites are session-started/bead-complete, not a 'research.cycle.completed' handler name found nowhere in source; corrected via grep of publish_to_bus("kb.session.indexed.v1", ...) call sites. Consumed by hearth-api for Android counter updates. UNCONSUMED (2026-07 zombie-event audit): the 'consumed by hearth-api' claim above is STALE/INCORRECT as of this audit — verified via full-text grep of hearth-api's nbus_consumer.rs dispatch table (handle_redis_event / classify_dispatch), which has no arm for kb.session.indexed.v1 (it does handle kb.entry.created.v1, kb.session.harvest.v1, kb.session.context.v1, kb.review.requested.v1, kb.brainstorm.checkpoint.v1, hearth.kb.approved.v1 — none of them this channel). Currently write-only telemetry; not removed (cheap, harmless bus write that may become useful later). See nervous-bus schemas/CHANNELS.md for current status.
